title: THE HISTORICAL SIGNIFICANCE OF SEALS IN THE STUDY OF MANUSCRIPTS OF JALAL AL DIN RUMI'S WORKS
description: This article examines seals found in manuscript copies of the works of Jalal al-Din Rumi held in the collection of the Institute of Oriental Studies of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan. It analyses the shape, content, inscriptional features, design, placement on the page, and recurrence of seals in the manuscripts under study. The article explains the significance of names, library information, waqf records, and ownership details contained in seal inscriptions for reconstructing manuscript history. It demonstrates how the study of seals can provide additional information about the provenance of manuscripts, their owners at different periods, and their history of use. The findings contribute to the assessment of the historical and cultural value of manuscripts of Jalal al-Din Rumi's works and establish the role of seals as an important source for their scholarly description. Furthermore, the placement of seals within a manuscript and the patterns of their recurrence help to determine the purposes for which they were applied and to identify aspects of manuscript use.
